answer: The strongest lever is simple: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because raven only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, wander is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any meadow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
